name: Collapsing Roof
trigger: A creature crosses a trip wire
description: A trip wire 3 inches off the ground topples two weak supports and brings down an unstable section of ceiling. Each creature beneath it makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.
avoid: Once detected, the trip wire can be easily cut or avoided (no ability check required).

name: Falling Net
trigger: A creature crosses a trip wire
description: A trip wire releases a weighted 10-foot-square Net on the first creature to cross it. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or have the Restrained condition until it escapes (Huge or larger succeeds automatically); an action and a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check frees a creature within reach.
avoid: Once detected, the trip wire can be easily cut or avoided (no ability check required).

name: Fire-Casting Statue
trigger: A creature moves onto a pressure plate
duration: Instantaneous, and the trap resets at the start of the next turn
description: A nearby statue exhales a 15-foot Cone of magical flame. Each creature in the Cone makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) Fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. A DC 10 Wisdom (Perception) check finds a glyph on the statue (defacing it disarms the trap); a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check finds the pressure plate (an Iron Spike under it stops the trap).
avoid: Wedging an Iron Spike or similar object under the pressure plate prevents the trap from triggering.

name: Hidden Pit
trigger: A creature moves onto the pit's lid
description: A 10-foot-deep pit under a hinged lid that matches the floor. A creature that moves onto the lid falls in and takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage. A DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check detects it; an Iron Spike wedged under the lid makes it safe to cross.
avoid: An Iron Spike or similar object wedged between the lid and the floor keeps the lid from opening.

name: Poisoned Darts
trigger: A creature moves onto a pressure plate
duration: Instantaneous, and the trap resets at the start of the next turn if it has activated fewer than three times
description: Poisoned darts shoot from hidden tubes in the walls. Each creature in their path makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or is struck by 1d3 darts, taking 3 (1d6) Poison damage per dart. A DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check finds the holes or the pressure plate.
avoid: Plugging the holes, or wedging an Iron Spike under the pressure plate, prevents the darts from firing.

name: Poisoned Needle
trigger: A creature opens the trap's lock improperly or fails to disarm the trap
description: A needle hidden in a lock stabs whoever opens it without the proper key: DC 11 Constitution saving throw, 5 (1d10) Poison damage and the Poisoned condition for 1 hour on a failure, half damage only on a success. A DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check finds the needle; a DC 15 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check disarms it, and a failed check triggers it.
avoid: The trap doesn't trigger if the lock is opened with a Knock spell or similar magic.

name: Rolling Stone
trigger: A creature moves onto a pressure plate
description: Deadly Trap (Levels 11-16) or Nuisance Trap (Levels 17-20). A 5-foot-radius orb of stone rolls 60 feet a turn; a creature whose space it enters makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or takes 55 (10d10) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition. A DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check deduces the pressure plate's function; an Iron Spike under it stops the trap.
avoid: Wedging an Iron Spike or a similar object under the pressure plate prevents the trap from triggering.

name: Spiked Pit
trigger: A creature moves onto the pit's lid
description: A 10-foot-deep pit with spikes at the bottom under a hinged lid. A creature that falls in takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Piercing damage. A DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check detects it; an Iron Spike wedged under the lid makes it safe to cross.
avoid: An Iron Spike or similar object wedged between the lid and the floor keeps the lid from opening.
